posts.title: The Half-Life of an Instruction
posts.description: Two French examples. That is all it took. I told DeepSeek’s larger model, V4 Pro, to translate every question into Russian. posts.title: No Logs, No Defence: Italy Makes AI Documentation Court-Orderable
posts.description: 27 July 2026. Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 enters into force. Brussels pushes the AI Act’s high-risk obligations - logging, risk management, technical documentation, human oversight - from 2 August 2026 to 2 December 2027 . 30 September 2026.
